data.name: Nubaid
data.gender_notes: Nubaid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-b-d' meaning 'to help' or 'to provide'. A name of great significance in Islam for those who wish to embody the spirit of generosity and compassion. The name Nubaid carries the meaning “Helpful, Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nubaid usually hope their child will grow to embody helpful, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the desire to be of service to others, and the belief that every act of kindness has the power to change lives.
data.etymology: Nubaid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helpful, Generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nubaid total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nubaid carries a deep cultural significance in the Islamic world, as it is associated with the concept of helping and providing assistance to those in need. This can be seen in various aspects of Islamic society, from the established practice of giving zakat (charitable donations) and sadaqah (voluntary giving), to the acts of kindness and generosity shown on a daily basis by individuals towards their families, neighbours, and communities. The name Nubaid can be seen as a reminder of the importance of these values, and may inspire those who bear it to strive towards a life of service and compassion.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Nubaid can be seen as a reflection of the Islamic belief in the importance of serving and helping others as a means of drawing closer to God. This is rooted in the concept of the meeting with God (ma'ad), where one's actions in this life will be weighed in the balance and determine their fate in the hereafter. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "The Son of Adam will not fill a container worse than his belly. It is sufficient for him to keep from seeking food before the time for it." (Bukhari and Muslim) By embodying the spirit of generosity and compassion embodied in the name Nubaid, one can not only strengthen their relationship with God, but also bring joy and comfort to those around them. Additionally, the name Nubaid can serve as a constant reminder of the importance of humility and gratitude, as all help and provision ultimately comes from God.
